neighbours.label: the token ' wet' (wet weather, wet ground)
fire: Drive slowly on the road during wet weather.
The dog came back with wet paws and muddy fur.
Do not touch the switch with wet hands.
The grass was still wet when we started the match.
Hang the wet towels outside to dry.
Spring here is usually cold and wet.
The paint is still wet, so keep the door open.
Pumps were added to drain the mine in wet seasons.
quiet: Drive slowly on the road during foggy weather.
The dog came back with dirty paws and muddy fur.
Do not touch the switch with bare hands.
The grass was still long when we started the match.
Hang the clean towels outside to air.
Spring here is usually cold and windy.
The paint is still fresh, so keep the door open.
Pumps were added to drain the mine in rainy seasons.

notes: Broad pole with mixed peaks (東 in place names, Interstate, -orders); ' wet' is the commonest English peak. Probe: 'wet weather' 0.25.
